# Do not edit Prisma Browser guides here

The guides in this folder and the release notes in `../release-notes/` are published from the internal
GitLab repo `prisma-access-browser-group/pb-developer-content`. Each publish opens a PR that replaces
every `.mdx` file in both folders, so an edit made directly here is overwritten.

Make changes in the content repo instead: open a merge request, check the preview, merge, and an API owner
publishes. Code in `src/components/PBPortal/` (outside these two folders) is still edited in pan.dev.
